name: tab03
definition: 业务记录表 Counterexample: 与 tab04 等表族成员的区别:它们是同一业务概念在不同厂区/层级/站点的副本,不构成独立概念;与物理实体类对象的区别:本对象是信息记录,不是实物。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table tab03; provenance: direct source tab03

name: tab04
scope: Records of table tab04; provenance: direct source tab04

name: Atom
definition: A single atom record within a molecule, identified by its atom id.

name: Bond
definition: A bond record connecting two atoms, identified by a bond id.

name: Molecule
definition: A molecule record identified by its molecule id.

name: Carcinogenic
definition: Molecules flagged as carcinogenic by the '+' label.

name: NonCarcinogenic
definition: Molecules flagged as non-carcinogenic by the '-' label.

name: BondAtom2
definition: The second atom id participating in a bond.

name: CarcinogenicMoleculePercentage
definition: Share of all molecules that are carcinogenic. Formula: Carcinogenic / Molecule. Inputs: Carcinogenic = tab04.fld007 WHERE fld007 = '+'; Molecule = tab04.fld002
aliases: percentage of molecules that are carcinogenic

name: NonCarcinogenicMoleculePercentage
definition: Share of all molecules that are non-carcinogenic. Formula: NonCarcinogenic / Molecule. Inputs: NonCarcinogenic = tab04.fld007 WHERE fld007 = '-'; Molecule = tab04.fld002

name: AverageBondsPerAtom
definition: Average number of bond records per atom for a given element. Formula: Bond / Atom. Inputs: Bond = tab03.fld004; Atom = tab03.fld001
aliases: average number of bonds per atom

name: DistinctAtomCount
definition: Count of unique atom ids matching a condition. Formula: COUNT(DISTINCT Atom). Inputs: Atom = tab03.fld001

name: Carcinogenicity
definition: Which molecules are carcinogenic vs non-carcinogenic and what share they represent.
